subject: physics
topic: Motion: speed, velocity, acceleration and equations of motion

kept.q: A danfo bus travels a distance of 150 km in 3 hours at a constant speed. Calculate the speed of the bus.
kept.explanation: Speed = distance / time = 150 km / 3 h = 50 km/h.
kept.pidgin: Speed na distance divide by time: 150 km divide by 3 h = 50 km/h.

kept.q: Which of the following best defines velocity of a moving body?
options: rate of change of distance with time
rate of change of speed with time
rate of change of displacement with time
rate of change of acceleration with time
kept.explanation: Velocity is a vector quantity defined as the rate of change of displacement (distance in a specified direction) with time, unlike speed which only considers distance.
kept.pidgin: Velocity na how fast displacement (distance with direction) dey change with time, e get direction unlike speed.

kept.q: Chidi drives from Enugu to Onitsha, a distance of 120 km, in 2 hours. He returns to Enugu along the same route in 3 hours. Calculate his average speed for the whole journey.
kept.explanation: Total distance = 120 km + 120 km = 240 km, total time = 2 h + 3 h = 5 h. Average speed = total distance / total time = 240/5 = 48 km/h.
kept.pidgin: Total distance na 240 km, total time na 5 hours, so average speed = 240/5 = 48 km/h.

kept.q: A motorcycle increases its velocity uniformly from 5 m/s to 25 m/s in 4 seconds. Calculate its acceleration.
kept.pidgin: Acceleration = (v minus u) divide by time = (25-5)/4 = 5 m/s^2.

kept.q: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 2 m/s^2 for 10 seconds. Calculate the distance it covers in this time.
kept.pidgin: Use s = ut + 1/2 at^2, since u = 0: s = 0.5 x 2 x 10^2 = 100 m.

kept.q: A football is kicked vertically upward with an initial velocity of 20 m/s. Taking g = 10 m/s^2 and ignoring air resistance, calculate the maximum height reached by the ball.
kept.explanation: At maximum height, final velocity v = 0. Using v^2 = u^2 - 2gh: 0 = 20^2 - 2(10)h, so 20h = 400, giving h = 20 m.
kept.pidgin: For the highest point, v = 0. From v^2 = u^2 - 2gh: 0 = 400 - 20h, so h = 400/20 = 20 m.
